name: What is the installation process for switchable privacy glass?

mainEntity.name: What is the installation process for switchable privacy glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing switchable privacy glass, also known as smart glass, involves replacing your existing window panes with the new glass units. These units contain a liquid crystal film that can be switched between transparent and opaque states via an electrical current. The process includes careful measurement, removal of old glass, installation of the new smart glass units, and wiring the glass to a power source and control switch. Our team handles all aspects, ensuring proper electrical connection and seamless operation.
